name: TypeScript interface DSL with Angular/Node/Qt code generator

mentions.name: TypeScript interface DSL with Angular/Node/Qt code generator
mentions.description: A DSL expressed in TypeScript syntax for declaring interfaces between a TypeScript application and its backend. Its code generator emits Angular classes and TypeScript types for the web app, a Node backend class to fill in with handlers for that interface, and a Qt widget that embeds the web application — including a functional Qt Designer plugin for dragging the widget into existing UI layouts — so UIs written for the web can be used either as regular Qt widgets or as standalone webapps with a Node backend.
mentions.audience: developers building TypeScript web apps who also want their UIs usable as Qt widgets
mentions.source_excerpt: I made this little DSL that's transported by the typescript syntax, but made for declaring interfaces between a typescript application and a backend.
